definitions.gloss: reluctantly; unwillingly; having no other choice
definitions.explanation: Describes doing something because there is no alternative, not because one wants to.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なかった→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、{仕方|しかた}なく⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}った→乗る：00511_noru⟧。
examples.english: Since there were no trains, I reluctantly took a taxi.

examples.japanese: {仕方|しかた}なく⟦{残業|ざんぎょう}→残業：01071_zangyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ことになった。
examples.english: I had no choice but to work overtime.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧⟦{手伝|てつだ}って→手伝う：00898_tetsudau⟧⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、{仕方|しかた}なく⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦やった→やる：02980_yaru⟧。
examples.english: Since no one would help me, I had no choice but to do it alone.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧ (way/method) + ⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (not exist) + く (adverb form)

From ⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ meaning 'there's no way/it can't be helped.'

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{仕方|しかた}→仕方：01603_shikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ / ⟦しょうがない→しょうがない：07381_shouganai⟧ - it can't be helped
- {仕方|しかた}なし⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ - reluctantly (slightly more literary)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{嫌々|いやいや}→嫌々：07795_iyaiya⟧ - reluctantly, unwillingly (emphasizes dislike)
- ⟦やむを{得|え}ず→やむを得ず：08528_yamuwoezu⟧ - unavoidably (formal)
- {渋々|しぶしぶ} - reluctantly (shows visible reluctance)

USAGE:
{仕方|しかた}なく implies acceptance of the situation; ⟦{嫌々|いやいや}→嫌々：07795_iyaiya⟧ emphasizes reluctance and displeasure.
